criteria.description: Create a ModelForm exposing only name, price and stock. Render field errors and preserve submitted input when validation fails. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Strip name whitespace in clean_name and reject an all-space value. Demonstrate " Pen " becomes Pen and "   " creates no product. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Create SaleForm with IntegerField(min_value=1). Demonstrate 3 accepted and 0, -1, "two" and "2.5" rejected with visible field errors. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Validate requested quantity against the selected product’s available stock. Starting stock 4, quantity 5 is rejected without changing the database. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Refactor the view to use cleaned_data or form.save only after is_valid. Explain why directly using request.POST bypasses your validated values. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Include csrf_token and a labelled submit button. Show GET renders an unbound form and invalid POST re-renders a bound form with errors. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Submit invalid values directly with Django’s test client rather than relying on HTML input restrictions. Record status, form errors and unchanged row count. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).
Independent verification: new normal case (3), boundary/failure case (3), reproducible commands and observed outputs (2), limitation and repair plan (2).
